# Engineered parameters

*Generated by `python -m amongusfly.experiments.param_table` from the code that uses these values. No connectome weight appears here: none is ever changed.*

## Fixed (never trained)

| Part | Parameter | Value | Unit | Role |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Body | `forward speed` | 2.0 | units/s | game speed of both roles; training uses the same speed |
| Body | `body radius` | 0.25 | units | kinematic unicycle with wall sliding |
| Body | `CAREFUL_CLEARANCE` | 0.55 | units | below this clearance the fly slows down |
| Body | `CAREFUL_MIN_FACTOR` | 0.45 | ×speed | slowest speed factor, at the wall |
| Planner | `BODY_CLEARANCE` | 0.3 | units | planned paths keep this far from walls |
| Planner | `REPLAN_AFTER_BLOCKED_S` | 0.6 | s | wall contact before the route is re-planned |
| Planner | `PROGRESS_UNITS` | 0.5 | units | getting this much closer counts as progress (commitment) |
| Planner | `WALL_REPEL_GAIN` | 1.5 |  | how hard the goal is bent away from a wall |
| Planner | `WALL_REPEL_RANGE` | 0.6 | units | clearance at which the bend fades out |
| Planner | `GOAL_SMOOTH_S` | 0.3 | s | time constant of the goal-direction low-pass filter |
| Planner | `AVOID_FREE_UNITS` | 0 | units | probe fan (off; centring replaces it) |
| Map | `MIN_VENT_CLEARANCE` | 0.3 | units | vents snap to the nearest cell this far from walls |
| Training | `SPIN_PENALTY` | 0.1 | points/s | walker fitness lost per second spinning on the spot |
| Training | `SPIN_WINDOW` | 2000 ms |  | window for the spin test (≥ 1 turn, < 1 unit progress) |
| Readout | `turn.deadband_hz` | 1 | Hz | left−right rate differences below this are ignored |
| Readout | `dash.threshold_hz` | 60 | Hz | mean DNp01 rate that triggers the escape dash |
| Readout | `goal_behind.source` | PFL2 | | the goal-behind turn reads this cell type's rate directly |
| Brain | `connectome_weight_scale` | 0.514 | | every connectome weight is multiplied by this |
| Compass | `r_max_hz` | 150 | Hz | peak rate of the EPG heading and FC2 goal bumps |
| Compass | `kappa` | 2 | | bump concentration (von Mises) |
| Compass | `heading_sign` | -1 | | world heading to preferred-angle frame |
| Compass | `goal_offset_deg` | 342 | deg | offset of the goal bump, set so turns have the right sign and PFL2 peaks with the goal behind |
| Compass | `pb_phase_convention` | mirror_R | | left/right bridge numbering |
